description.short: Collaborative fiction project featuring a fictional organization that secures, contains, and protects anomalous objects and entities.
description.long: The SCP Foundation is a creative writing project that began on 4chan's /x/ paranormal board in 2007. It presents itself as a fictional secret organization that documents and contains supernatural phenomena, anomalous objects, and dangerous entities. The project uses a wiki format where contributors write clinical reports about numbered anomalies (SCPs) in a mock-scientific style. While entirely fictional, the Foundation's documentation style and collaborative nature have made it one of the internet's most influential horror fiction projects, spawning games, artwork, and a vast interconnected universe. Content is shared under Creative Commons licensing.

status.explanation: Documented fictional creation that originated on 4chan in 2007 and evolved into a collaborative creative writing project

cultural_impact.significance: Major influence on internet horror fiction and collaborative storytelling
cultural_impact.modern_usage: Active community with thousands of articles, games, merchandise, and adaptations
